The Little Mermaid at Bristol Old Vic is a feast for all the senses.

cn.t: Critics largely praise this eco-conscious reimagining, highlighting stunning aerial performances and inventive staging. Some find the adaptation uneven, but Liana Cottrill's lead performance wins consistent acclaim.
